# Activity Vault

The all-in-one activity archive for teachers and after-school program teachers.
Hundreds of real, classic, public-domain activity concepts — filterable by age, time,
group size, materials, and category. Plan-my-week planner. Printable one-page cards.

## Categories
- Seasons: 68 activities — Activities that ride the turning year — fall leaves, winter making, spring planting, summer play.
- Holidays: 65 activities — Festive projects and games for the days the whole group looks forward to.
- Crafts: 103 activities — Hands-on making: fold it, paint it, build it, take it home.
- STEM: 83 activities — Experiments, engineering challenges, and satisfying science demos.
- PE & Movement: 69 activities — Run, jump, dance — activities that burn off the wiggles.
- Team & Community: 74 activities — Turn a group into a crew: cooperation, trust, and belonging.
- Icebreakers: 33 activities — First-day friendly: learn names, laugh, and loosen up fast.
- Outdoor: 70 activities — Fresh-air activities for fields, playgrounds, and nature walks.
- Rainy Day: 35 activities — Stuck inside? These keep a roomful of kids happy without a gym.
- Quiet & Focus: 69 activities — Wind-down worthy: calm, creative, individual or small-group.
- Music & Rhythm: 11 activities — Drums, shakers, rhythm games, and songs — make some noise.

## API — start at api/v1/index.json (self-describing manifest)
- api/v1/index.json — api manifest
- api/v1/activities.json — full activity library
- api/v1/categories.json — category definitions
- api/v1/filters.json — filter configuration
- api/v1/skills.json — skills registry
- api/v1/collections.json — curated collections
- api/v1/balance-buckets.json — energy balance buckets

## Skills
- skills/activity-finder.md — Find the right activity fast using age, time, group size, and materials-on-hand filters.
- skills/balanced-week-builder.md — Build auto-balanced multi-week activity plans with an energy balance meter, prep caps, and no repeats — the Smart Weekly Planner 3.0 recipe (brain breaks, weather backups, supply lists, substitute kits).
- skills/halloween-party-planner.md — Turn party constraints into a timed station-rotation plan from seasonal activities. Covers the Halloween, winter, spring, and summer party presets.
- skills/icebreaker-chooser.md — Pick first-day and new-group icebreakers matched to group size and shyness level.
- skills/no-prep-rescue.md — Grab-and-go activities that need zero prep and zero (or near-zero) materials.
- skills/outdoor-play-picker.md — Pick the right outdoor activity for the space, weather, and energy level you have.
- skills/quiet-focus-picker.md — Pick wind-down and calm-focus activities to land a loud group or fill a calm slot.
- skills/rainy-day-rescue.md — Instant indoor plan when the weather kills outdoor time.
- skills/stem-demo-picker.md — Pick the right STEM demo or engineering challenge for the age group and time available.
- skills/sub-tub-rescue.md — Build a print-ready substitute-teacher emergency plan for any grade band and time gap.
- skills/week-planner.md — Build a no-repeat week of activities from days, slots, and constraints.

## Tools
- sub.html — Sub Tub: the substitute-teacher rescue kit.
  Pick grade band, minutes to fill, materials on hand, location —
  generates a sequenced print-ready emergency plan plus a 'Dear sub' note template.
- party.html — Party Planner (Halloween, Thanksgiving, winter, spring, and summer presets).
  Pick a theme, class size, minutes, stations, and budget — generates a timed
  station-rotation plan from seasonal activities, plus a setup list and a
  print-ready run sheet.
- halloween.html — Halloween hub: the Halloween 2026 pack's crafts, costume and
  party games, not-too-spooky science, harvest activities, and trick-or-treat
  alternatives, plus the Haunted Halls collection, a Halloween party-theme shortcut,
  and a spookiness-level filter.
- spring.html — Spring hub: the spring 2027 pack's crafts, outdoor games,
  spring science, rainy-day backups, and spring-holiday activities, plus the
  Spring Burst collection and a spring party-theme shortcut.
- summer.html — Summer hub: the summer 2027 pack's water play, outdoor games,
  summer crafts, beat-the-heat indoor backups, and camp + July 4th activities,
  plus the Summer Splash collection and a summer party-theme shortcut.
- fieldtrip.html — Field Trip Planner: destination, group size, and trip length
  become a clock-time timeline, chaperone and buddy-pair math, a budget estimate,
  on-site activity ideas matched from the real library, bus-ride activities from the
  field-trip-bus-ride collection, and printable permission-slip + pack checklists.
- thanksgiving.html — Thanksgiving hub: the Thanksgiving 2026 pack's gratitude
  crafts, harvest games, Thanksgiving STEM, gratitude and friendsgiving activities,
  and giving-back projects, plus the Grateful Gathering collection and a
  Thanksgiving party-theme shortcut.
- planner.html — Smart Weekly Planner 2.0: program presets (after-school / camp /
  classroom), age bands, auto-built no-repeat weeks with a per-day energy balance meter,
  drag-and-drop reorder, per-slot swap, surprise gap-fill, prep-level caps, collection
  seeding (?from=collection:<id>), named saved plans, .ics calendar export, shareable
  ?plan= links, and a print-ready card deck.
- collections.html — Curated collections: 12 teacher-ready bundles (rainy-day
  rescue, first day, sub tub, winter party, spring burst, summer splash, haunted halls, grateful gathering…)
  each with a curator's note per pick; printable and copy-able per collection.
- api.html — API docs with a Try-the-API console (endpoint picker, fetch, pretty JSON).

## Docs
- API.md — full API reference
- PIPELINE.md — how the library grows
- AGENT.md — how an agent uses this archive: endpoints, example requests,
  end-to-end workflows (filtering, party planning, week planning)
